titleCard.paragraph1: Best of India brings the rich flavours of South Indian and Chettinad cuisine to your celebrations, with catering in Paris and the Île-de-France region.
titleCard.paragraph2: Whether you are planning a wedding, a corporate event, an engagement, a baby shower, a reception or a birthday party, our team will help you create the right menu for your event and your budget. If your occasion is not listed below, simply get in touch.

about.heading: The Taste of Southern India at Your Event
about.paragraph1: Best of India is your destination for authentic South Indian cuisine in Paris. We specialise in Chettinad cuisine, one of the richest and most refined culinary traditions of South India. Originating in Tamil Nadu, it is known for its character, its intense spices and its balance of boldness and subtlety.
about.paragraph2: Every dish is prepared according to traditional recipes, with a unique blend of freshly ground spices such as black pepper, fennel, cinnamon and curry leaves. We select our ingredients carefully to guarantee freshness, quality and respect for Indian culinary traditions.
about.paragraph3: Our catering service brings this same care to your celebration, with a menu shaped around your occasion, your guests and your budget.
